resources.string: Preview a declared non-secret subset and create ordinary SSH profiles. Nothing is connected, executed or saved as a credential.
Supported: Host aliases, HostName and Port. User, IdentityFile, ProxyJump, forwards, Match, Include and other directives are reported as unsupported and are never imported.
Input exceeded the 64 KiB or 64-profile import bound; the preview is truncated.
Import stopped: %2$s. Profiles created before stopping: %1$d. Existing profiles were preserved.
